translations.title: Folic Acid 1 mg Tablet
translations.efficacy: This medicine is used to prevent and treat folic acid deficiency, to supply folic acid during pregnancy and breastfeeding, and for anaemia linked to folic acid deficiency — such as anaemia from poor nutrition, anaemia in pregnancy, and anaemia in children.
translations.usage: To treat folic acid deficiency, adults and children 24 months or older take 0.25–1 mg a day. To prevent it, or when the body needs more, take 0.1–0.25 mg a day.
translations.caution: Do not take this if you have ever reacted to it, or if you have pernicious anaemia or megaloblastic anaemia caused by vitamin B12 deficiency (it can mask the cause of the anaemia), or if you have an inherited condition such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose malabsorption. Talk to a pharmacist before taking it if you are taking a folate-metabolism inhibitor such as methotrexate or trimethoprim, an anti-epileptic such as phenytoin, sulfasalazine or cholestyramine, or if you are under a doctor's care. If there is no improvement after about a month, stop taking it.
